easy.name: Pip
easy.bio: The club's newest member. Misses things, forgets to look again, and is delighted when you punish it.

style.chess: Picks moves like Lichess players in the lowest rating band, never from the unlikely long tail, so its slips are ordinary ones.
style.four: Plays its learned policy with a little randomness and no look-ahead.
style.word: Guesses any word that fits what it knows, and sometimes overlooks a clue.
style.fighter: Short strings, blocks late, never punishes.
style.arena: Walks open lanes and aims after you do.
style.fleet: Fires at random and usually forgets to follow up a hit.

medium.name: Marlow
medium.bio: A regular who punishes the obvious and lets the subtle go. Steady, polite, never in a hurry.

style.chess: Picks moves like Lichess players in the middle rating band, drawing from the full spread of what they play, but skipping moves that hang material.
style.four: Looks ahead with a short search before each move.
style.holdem: Calls often and avoids going all in with weaker starting hands.
style.word: Guesses the most common word that fits every clue.
style.fighter: Anti-airs on reaction, drops long combos.
style.arena: Holds angles, trades evenly in open fights.
style.fleet: Hunts every other square, then works around a hit.

hard.name: Vesper
hard.bio: The evening sharp. Patient, exact, and quick to turn a slip into the whole game.

style.chess: Picks from the moves a top-band Lichess player would most likely play, always takes a mate when it sees it, skips moves that hang material, and avoids repeating a won position.
style.four: Looks further ahead than Marlow before each move.
style.holdem: Mixes bets and protects strong starting hands.
style.word: Picks the guess from the remaining candidates that splits them best.
style.fighter: Whiff punishes and full combos on counter hit.
style.arena: Pre-aims common peeks and wins first contact.
style.fleet: Hunts where ships fit best, then works around a hit.

champion.name: Sable
champion.bio: The house champion. Human-like play with a carefully recorded reaction limit.

style.chess: Searches ahead with a learned position evaluator and a fixed search budget.
style.four: Runs the deepest search the site has, within about a second and a half.
style.holdem: Mixes choices and protects strong starting hands.
style.word: Looks a further guess ahead, choosing from every allowed word.
style.fighter: Reacts at the minimum delay; still blocks like a person.
style.fleet: Fires at the most likely square every time, hunting or finishing.

result_reaction_templates.loss_to_human: {turn} was the move I did not see. I rated {miss} as holding and it did not. Good game.
result_reaction_templates.win_over_human: {turn} is where it turned. Try {alt} there next time; I had no answer to it.
result_reaction_templates.draw: Neither of us found a way through after {turn}. Even game.
result_reaction_templates.human_resigned: You resigned at move {n}. The position was lost, but it was closer than it looked after {turn}.
